localContext: Colorado Springs is a military and space city: Fort Carson, Peterson and Schriever Space Force Bases, Cheyenne Mountain and the Air Force Academy, with several large aerospace and defence contractors keeping sites nearby. Pueblo's steel mill, Front Range utilities, Cripple Creek mining and I-25 construction add structural and pressure-equipment work. Machined, welded and composite parts are inspected to customer specifications, so PT, MT, UT and ET lead demand alongside strict record control.
certPathwayNote: Employers certify under a written practice based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A: training hours, logged experience, general, specific and practical examinations, a vision test, then employer certification. Defence and space customers flow down procedure and record requirements that the employer's Level III reconciles with the written practice. Colorado radiography needs state radiation licensing, separate from method certification.
